MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth, DATE('2026-10-14') AS today
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE_DIFF('year', birth, today) - CASE WHEN (DATE_PART('month', today) * 100 + DATE_PART('day', today)) < (DATE_PART('month', birth) * 100 + DATE_PART('day', birth)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, CAST(p.birth_date AS DATE) AS birth, CAST('2026-10-14' AS DATE) AS today
WITH p.nationality AS nationality,
     DATE_PART('year', today) - DATE_PART('year', birth) - CASE
       WHEN DATE_PART('month', today) < DATE_PART('month', birth)
         OR (DATE_PART('month', today) = DATE_PART('month', birth) AND DATE_PART('day', today) < DATE_PART('day', birth))
       THEN 1 ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
